job.job_title: Walk-in || AI/Data Platform Engineer - Python, LLM, ML_Walkin Drive_22nd August
job.job_description:
Role & responsibilities

Design and develop robust Python applications and APIs for AI/LLM-based services.
Fine-tune, evaluate, and deploy LLMs using frameworks like Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, or OpenAI APIs.
Build and optimize pipelines for prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and model inference.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate LLMs into real-world applications (e.g., chatbots, summarization tools, code generation).
Implement scalable backend systems using FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
job.ai_reason: Strong production RAG experience and transferable cloud skills.
